name: CoalMine Methane-Risk Identification
transformation: Existing project v6 task construction repackaged into a single JSON file. Questions, choices, IDs, timestamps, client assignments, labels and construction roles are preserved. Added explicit split and answer fields; no raw sensor streams are included.
evaluation_note: Historically selected final CoalMine operating points were post-hoc test-set-tuned diagnostics, not unbiased held-out estimates. This release provides a small integration example, not reproduction of those operating points.
